search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 路-seal.svg 路 bronze 史懋壺 character glyph
search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced Commons file pages for 路 seal, bronze, and big-seal graphics. Opened the seal and bronze description pages and checked their descriptions, source attribution, and rights statements. The direct seal SVG request and Commons imageinfo API request failed; no pixels were visually inspected in this run.

gaps: The 路-seal.svg description page provides an original-file link and public-domain terms, but the direct SVG request failed with a cache miss and the imageinfo API was inaccessible. Its exact graphic therefore remains pending visual review before final selection.

The 路-bronze.svg page identifies a Western Zhou style redraw and cites 史懋壺 (集成09714), but the artifact image itself was not visually inspected. The page’s description is provenance for the redraw, not independent verification of the inscription reading or meaning.
